implementation: Round 2 Returns Manager pipeline (Gemini vision session + deterministic validation, identity fusion, completeness, Amazon-condition grading and rules engine) behind a Round 3 adapter. Default replay mode reads cassettes; live/record mode calls Gemini (needs GEMINI_API_KEY).
notes: The committed demo captures in data/input/<unit>/returns/ are placeholder images and the 8 committed cassettes are hand-authored (provenance=synthetic, labelled synthetic-cassette in evidence): they exercise the pipeline, rules and hand-offs, not the model. Replace with real photos and record cassettes with agents/returns/tools/record_cassette.py. Units without captures fail open as no_reference_photo.
